title: On a stability of time-optimal version of the Boundary Control method
summary: Let $Ω$ be a Riemannian manifold with boundary. The time-optimal version of the BC-method determines the parameters in the $T$-neigh\-bor\-hood $Ω^T$ of $\partialΩ$ from the boundary observations (response operator) $R^{2T}$ on the time segment $[0,2T]$. It visualizes the invisible waves supported in $Ω^T$, by reconstructing the operator $W^T$ that creates these waves. The visualization is based on the triangular factorization of the operator $C^T:=W^{T\,*}W^T$ in the form $C^T:=F^{T\,*}F^T$ with a factor $F^T=U^{T}W^T$, where $U^T$ is a unitary operator.
